regulator: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
unit_of_observation: One source-reported adjusted annual notification headline from the 2025 annual report
source_threshold: The published headline excludes notifications associated with two major incidents, as explained in the annual report.
source_population: CNIL's adjusted annual notification population, not every submission and not unique incidents.
public_window: The reviewed 2025 annual headline, published in May 2026.
correction_process: Recheck the official annual headline and the methodological note on page 52 of the annual report. Any change to the adjustment or reporting year requires parser and scope review.
limitations: The 2025 headline excludes 11,635 notifications associated with two incidents from the 17,802 received.
The adjustment belongs to the regulator and is not an incident-deduplication claim by this project.
This headline is separate from CNIL's anonymised dataset and must not be added to its grouped counts.
The adapter reads a fixed reviewed reporting year; new annual publications require review.
name: CNIL annual data breach statistics
